name: Asakura (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Asakura city emblem in green and blue: a green stylised mountain above a blue curved stroke.
history: Municipal flag of Asakura, a city in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 20 March 2006.

features.role: Asakura city emblem — a green stylised mountain above a blue curved stroke
